item.title: Kyonyuu Hitozuma 3P Saimin ~Saimin de Netorasete Itadakimasu!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Jaren
  • 発売日: 2016-07-29
  • スコア: 6.590000000000001/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巨乳人妻3P催眠 ～催眠で寝取らせていただきます！～
  • 英語名: Kyonyuu Hitozuma 3P Saimin Saimin de Netorasete Itadakimasu!

あらすじ

The protagonist is obsessed with married women as he believes they are superior in every way - experienced in bed, confident, and loved by their partners. Despite lacking the ability to pursue them aggressively, he dreams of being with them intimately. One night, he gets drunk and reveals his sexual cravings at a brothel, where he is given a book on hypnotism. Upon reading it, he finds himself in possession of the power to hypnotize people and sets his sights on the married women he has been fixated on, particularly his landlord, boss, and a teacher who reside near him. With his new-found power, he manipulates them into having sex with him and plans to do so with even more married women. His lust shows no sign of abating.

Unless he makes a wrong choice that bring him back to a boring life, he will go further and further in this world.

あらすじ

Kazuma works at a TV company. One day, he gets a special power by chance. He can now emit radio waves and people who receive them follow his orders. He doesn’t know why, but he enjoys a life full of sex using it. A while later, he hears a rumor that girls often get involved in rape cases. He knows it’s not him, so who’s behind it?
